description.zh:
更新的回访状态，有以下枚举
0：未回访
1：无人接听
2：需再次回访
3：号码无效
4：回访成功
5：无需回访
description.en:
The callback status to update. Valid values:

0: not called back
1: no answer
2: requires another callback
3: invalid number
4: callback succeeded
5: no callback needed.
The extension field. The value is a JSON string.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.
The unique primary key of the data.
